name: doperpowers
description: One software-development methodology for coding agents, sized by the work: brainstorm, design, spec, TDD, review, ship — run in order from the spec itself when one agent can own it, or through an execution plan with a fresh subagent per task when it takes more, and the same method unattended on the board loop.

interface.shortDescription: Planning, TDD, debugging, and delivery workflows for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Use Doperpowers to guide agent work through brainstorming, execution planning, test-driven development, systematic debugging, parallel execution, code review, and finish-the-branch workflows.
defaultPrompt: I've got an idea for something I'd like to build.
Let's add a feature to this project.
